question: Aaron is 5 years younger than Ron. Four years later from now, Ron will be twice as old as Aaron. Find Ron’s present age.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The age difference (5 years) remains constant forever.

Ratio after 4 years (Ron : Aaron) = 2 : 1.

Difference in ratio = 2 − 1 = 1 unit = 5 years.

Ron age in 4 years = 2 units = 2 × 5 = 10 years.

Ron present age = 10 − 4 = 6 years.

**∴ Answer = 6 years**
